// diagnostic

E3530

Build rule code `{code}` is reserved.

What

Build rule code `{code}` is reserved.

Why

Codes beginning with E or W followed only by digits belong to the compiler.

Fix

use a project prefix such as `ORG01`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3530: tests/ui/build_enforce_reserved_code.stderr.

Error [E3530]: build rule code `E9000` is reserved
